_comment: Source of the overheard phrases; scripts/build_phrases.py turns it into locale/<lang>/overheard.json. Long phrases on purpose: few phones = many false hits, and stage 2 (STT + good manners' word lists) catches the short words anyway. No slurs. 'en' is listened for in every language, also with the local pronunciation. 'lookalikes' are innocent sentences that sound close; they are used by the tests, not by the plugin. 'heard' holds phones the model itself heard Piper voices say (scripts/heard_phones.py). Lists for ca, eu, gl and pt need a native speaker's review.
